limits: Six jurisdictions are a useful expansion frontier, not a global inventory. Other lists and primary microbial literature remain unsearched.
No source list establishes microbial mechanism, biological causality, industrial performance or mineral-species identity.
EU historical original was rechecked locally; fresh remote content was blocked.
Group expansion is performed only where issuer membership was inspected; unresolved groups remain explicit.
Criticality materials do not delimit the full CMMMech ontology; secondary resources and host minerals require additional evidence-led discovery.
